title: Fall Hazard Survey for Lookout Point Dam, Lowell, Oregon.

detail_text: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLICIT DIRECTLY TO SMALL BUSINESS VENDORS (RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(i)) Solicitation Number: W9127N26QA047 Agency: Department of the Army Office: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Location: USACE District, Portland Classification Code: H342 – Inspection – Fire Fighting/Rescue/Safety Equipment; Environ Protect Equipment/Materials NAICS Code: 541690 – Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services Notice Type: Notice of Intent to Solicit Directly from Suppliers IAW. RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(i). This is a pre-solicitation notice, IAW RFO FAR 5.1. Synopsis: This is a special notice prepared in accordance with the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 5.1 “Pre-solicitation Notice.” The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Portland District intends to solicit this directly to small business providers as a firm-fixed-price service contract to procure a Fall Hazard Survey for Lookout Point Dam, Lowell, Oregon. This action will be a 100% small business set-aside. The statutory authority for this RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(i). A SOLICITATION WILL NOT BE POSTED The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Portland District intends to solicit this directly to small business vendors as a firm-fixed-price service contract to procure a Fall Hazard Survey for Lookout Point Dam, Lowell, Oregon. The NAICS Code: 541690 – Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS OR QUOTATIONS Interested concerns must show clear and convincing evidence that competition of this requirement would be advantageous to the Government by submitting a capability statement that they have ability to supply the required supplies meeting the government’s need. If no affirmative written responses are received by 11:00 AM PST on 24 MARCH 2026 , the solicitation will be made directly to suppliers. Oral communications are not acceptable in response to this notice. A determination by the Government not to solicit this action on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) is solely within the discretion of the Government, IAW RFO FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(i). Electronic responses and questions shall be submitted via email to the contracting point of contact listed below. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is not responsible for any costs incurred by responding to this notice. Contracting Office Point of Contact: Raymie Briddell, Raymie.L.Briddell@usace.army.mil
